info.title: TedixHunt Participant gameplay — PROPOSAL ONLY
info.description: Task 5C documentation-only implementation handoff. These four gameplay paths are NOT implemented or served by /api/docs.json. Existing enrollment/rejoin, checkpoint access/proximity and radius setup routes from #95/#96 remain separate runtime contracts. All 22 custom mechanics remain blocked from Hunt publication. Team success awards exactly +100 once, including automatic five-minute recovery; no partial/per-member/normalized Team points. Solo/Team share one checkpoint/FinishPoint engine; huntCompleted means subject success, never global Hunt closure. See Participant_Gameplay_Contract.md and Participant_Gameplay_Decisions.md for approved rules, residual policy gates and missing individual/recovery activity transports.

get.description: Only allowlisted interaction and caller-authorized earned private information. Assignment alone never discloses a fragment. Team delivery includes persisted activity/fragment/collective flags, authoritative five-minute deadline and revisions. Checks current membership, access, exact pinned source plus effective radius digest and stage. D5 activity/recovery binding and D8 memory phase remain implementation gates.

post.description: Strict server-authoritative Personal or collective Team answer. Requires current actor/membership, pinned execution digest, active Hunt, valid access grant, checkpoint order, suspension and stage guard; Team also requires current membership/allocation revisions. Transaction records attempt, completion, approved score events and unlock once. Team collective success requires earned fragments and all required member activities before automatic five-minute recovery; after recovery unfinished originals no longer block, fragments and valid collective solution still mandatory. Team +100 once, normal or recovery, no partial points. This is not the original/recovery individual activity submission API.

ScoreSummary.description: Authoritative separate categories. teamChallengePoints is the scoped Team total, zero for Solo. Null Personal/other totals mean the category has no approved configured execution policy, not earned zero. No combined leaderboard is inferred.

TeamExecution.description: Caller-authorized persisted Team stage state; no roster or private assignment map. Deadline is exactly five minutes after server availability; D2 defines the precise availability event and pause handling before implementation. Recovery is automatic when required individual work remains unfinished at deadline. Activation does not reveal fragments, solve the collective puzzle or award points. Aggregate activity/fragment flags remain distinct from caller completion. Revision preconditions never confer authorization.

x-contract-gaps: Collective Team answer schemas below do not define per-member original/recovery activity transports. Define those against D5-approved immutable activity/fragment/recovery bindings before Team implementation; no generic skip or answer bypass.

Admission/Team formation, GPS lifetime/fallback, suspension, availability/pause timing, non-Team score categories and Legacy execution-policy selection retain explicit Product Owner gates. No 30-second age or 5-metre accuracy policy is approved here.
Hints remain gated and excluded from the minimum pilot proposal pending D4 approval. No solution endpoint. Seven-stop Signal ends at checkpoint seven FinishPoint; no eighth gameplay operation.
